name: Lucky Stars
source:
You’ve become the manager of a rock band of furry bad boys called Lucky. They’re notorious for being difficult to work with. Can you handle them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你已经成为一支由毛茸茸的坏男孩组成的摇滚乐队Lucky的经理。他们因难以合作而臭名昭著。你能应付他们吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
